chat.title: AI health assistant
chat.subtitle: Answers from reviewed health content. Not a doctor.
chat.welcomeBody: Describe a symptom or ask a health question. In an emergency, call 108.
chat.disclaimer: General guidance only. For a diagnosis or medicines, see a doctor.
chat.emergencyBody: Do not wait for the assistant. Call for help now.

demo.fever: Demo answer: rest, drink fluids, and take paracetamol as advised on the pack. See a doctor if the fever is above 102°F, lasts more than 3 days, or comes with a rash, stiff neck or breathing trouble.
demo.headache: Demo answer: rest in a quiet room, drink water, and avoid screens. A sudden severe headache, or one with vomiting, weakness or blurred vision, needs a doctor today.
demo.bp: Demo answer: sit quietly for 5 minutes and measure again. Readings of 140/90 or more on two occasions, or any reading with headache, chest pain or swelling, need a doctor. In pregnancy, go the same day.
demo.cough: Demo answer: warm fluids and steam help most coughs. A cough over 2 weeks, blood in sputum, night sweats or weight loss should be checked for TB at the nearest PHC.
demo.pregnancy: Demo answer: keep your antenatal check-ups and iron tablets. Bleeding, severe headache, swelling of face or hands, or reduced baby movements need care today.
demo.medicine: Demo answer: take medicines exactly as written on the prescription. Use the Prescription scanner in this app to set reminders, and ask a pharmacist about any doubt.
demo.general: Demo answer: the health assistant server is not reachable right now, so this is a sample reply. For anything urgent, call 108 or visit the nearest PHC.
